title_zh: 请药师联系医生核实妊娠期间的处方问题

scenario.label_zh: 向药房说明妊娠与处方疑问
scenario.goal_zh: 顾客说明妊娠及药品疑问，药师安排联系处方医生核实并请顾客留下等待

context_zh: 虚构药房内的沟通练习，不提供具体药品或剂量建议。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Naomi
sentences.text: Is there somewhere private in the pharmacy where I can ask about this prescription?

sentences.speaker: Pharmacist
sentences.text: Yes, we can use the consultation room. What's your concern?

sentences.speaker: Naomi
sentences.text: I've just found out I'm pregnant. I don't know whether the physician who wrote this was aware.

sentences.speaker: Pharmacist
sentences.text: Thank you for telling me. I'll contact the prescriber to check the instructions.

sentences.speaker: Naomi
sentences.text: I brought the box because I wasn't sure whether this pill was the one mentioned in the letter.

sentences.speaker: Pharmacist
sentences.text: That will help us identify it. I won't guess from its appearance. Would you wait here while I make the call?

sentences.speaker: Naomi
sentences.text: Yes, I'll wait. Please let them know about the pregnancy.
